meta.title: 4个万能拍照构图技巧，新手秒拿捏
meta.title_en: 4 Universal Photo-Composition Tricks Beginners Instantly Nail

scenes.context: 拍全身不是仰拍，而是站起来、手机跟胸部齐平、后退两米，人物放在画面中下两格。语域：拍照教学，构图技巧。
sentences: 拍全身，不要仰拍。
For full-body shots, don't shoot from below.
shoot from below（仰拍）
手机跟胸部齐平，后退两米。
Phone level with your chest, back up two meters.
level with your chest（与胸齐平）
人物放在中下两格。
Place the subject in the middle-lower two cells.
middle-lower two cells（中下两格）
paraphrase: 仰拍 → shoot from below / low angle
中下两格 → middle-lower two cells / lower third
scenes.speak: For full-body shots, don't shoot from below. Phone level with your chest, back up two meters. Place the subject in the middle-lower two cells.

scenes.context: 拍半身：手机镜头与鼻子齐平、后退1.5米、放大1.5倍、手机微微外翻15度、眼睛卡在上面一条线。语域：拍照教学，半身技巧。
sentences: 镜头与鼻子齐平。
Level the lens with your nose.
level the lens（镜头齐平）
后退 1.5 米，放大 1.5 倍。
Back up 1.5 meters and zoom 1.5×.
zoom 1.5×（放大1.5倍）
手机外翻 15 度，眼睛卡在一条线。
Tilt the phone 15°, eyes on the top line.
eyes on the top line（眼睛卡线）
paraphrase: 外翻 → tilt outward / angle out
卡线 → line up on / rest on the line
line up on · rest on the line
scenes.speak: Level the lens with your nose. Back up 1.5 meters and zoom 1.5×. Tilt the phone 15°, eyes on the top line.

scenes.context: 拍蹲姿：摄影师也要蹲下、手机和脸平行、放大1.5倍、侧身对镜头、头顶卡在上面一条线。语域：拍照教学，蹲姿技巧。
sentences: 拍蹲姿，摄影师也要蹲下。
For squat shots, the shooter squats too.
the shooter squats（摄影师蹲下）
手机和脸平行，放大 1.5 倍。
Phone parallel to your face, zoom 1.5×.
parallel to your face（与脸平行）
侧身对镜头，头顶卡线。
Turn sideways, crown on the top line.
crown on the top line（头顶卡线）
paraphrase: 蹲姿 → squat shot / crouched pose
头顶 → crown / top of the head
scenes.speak: For squat shots, the shooter squats too. Phone parallel to your face, zoom 1.5×. Turn sideways, crown on the top line.

scenes.context: 拍坐姿：让摄影师走到侧面、后退一米、人物在画面里形成对角线。四个技巧都好上手，快学起来。语域：拍照教学，坐姿收尾。
sentences: 拍坐姿，摄影师走到侧面。
For seated shots, the shooter moves to the side.
moves to the side（走到侧面）
后退一米，形成对角线。
Back up one meter to form a diagonal.
form a diagonal（形成对角线）
四个技巧，新手都能学会。
All four tricks are easy for beginners.
easy for beginners（新手易学）
paraphrase: 拿捏 → nail it / master it
scenes.speak: For seated shots, the shooter moves to the side. Back up one meter to form a diagonal. All four tricks are easy for beginners.

practice: Phone level with your chest, back up two meters.
Level the lens with your nose.
For squat shots, the shooter squats too.
Back up one meter to form a diagonal.
pitfalls: For full-body shots, don't shoot from below.
「不要仰拍」用 don't shoot from below。
「后退+放大」组合用 back up and zoom。
For squat shots, the shooter squats too.
shifts: 说拍照只会 take a photo
用 full-body shots（全身）、half-body shots（半身）、squat shots（蹲姿）
用 level with your chest（与胸齐平）、line up on（卡线）、parallel to（平行）
用 diagonal（对角线）、lower third（下三分之一）、tilt outward（外翻）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：不仰拍、手机与胸齐平、后退两米、中下两格、镜头与鼻齐平、后退1.5米、放大1.5倍、外翻15度、眼睛卡线、摄影师蹲下、脸平行、头顶卡线、走到侧面、对角线等。
